description: Seventeen field keys, all individually well-formed, where one key's VALUE is invalid. Reports invalid-field-value, not too-many-fields — §5's value-pattern row (11) precedes the count row (12), exactly as the key-pattern row (10) does. Companion to fields-bad-key-with-seventeen-keys.json, one row down: that case pins row 10 before row 12, this one pins row 11 before row 12. A binding that checks the count before checking values would answer too-many-fields here and still pass every other case, fields-seventeen-rejected included, since that case's seventeen values are all individually valid.
